name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  induction post <;> simp_all [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
    Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case fvar => simp [List.Subset]
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    repeat' apply List.Subset.app
    all_goals
      apply List.Subset.trans
      · assumption
      · intros x hx
        grind
        all_goals cases hx <;> simp_all
  case quant trih eih =>
    repeat' apply List.Subset.app
    all_goals
      apply List.Subset.trans
      · assumption
      · intros x hx
        simp_all
        all_goals cases hx <;> simp_all
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    repeat' apply List.Subset.app
    all_goals
      apply List.Subset.trans
      · assumption
      · intros x hx
        simp_all
        all_goals cases hx <;> simp_all
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split
      · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
      · simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
        intros x Hin
        exact ih2 Hin
    · simp only [imp_false] at *
      apply List.Subset.app
      · apply List.Subset.trans ih1
        intros x hx
        grind
        all_goals cases hx <;> simp_all
      · apply List.Subset.trans ih2
        intros x hx
        simp_all
        all_goals cases hx <;> simp_all

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have happ {α : Type} {a b c d : List α} (ha : a.Subset c) (hb : b.Subset d) :
      (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ d) := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [List.mem_append] at hx ⊢
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · exact Or.inl (ha hx)
    · exact Or.inr (hb hx)
  intro h
  induction h <;> simp_all [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, extractOldExprVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  case app =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · intro x hx
      exact hx
    · next Hfalse =>
      exfalso
      have hf := (show IsOldPred _ → IsFvar _ from by assumption) IsOldPred.oldPred
      cases hf
      apply Hfalse
      rfl
    · (expose_names; exact happ a_ih a_ih_1)

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  refine ⟨updatedStates σ ks' vs', rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength Hinit)
      (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup)
      (InitStatesNodup Hinit)
  · have Hdis : ks.Disjoint ks' := by
      intro k hk hk'
      have hdef := UpdateStatesDefined Hup k hk
      have hnone := InitStatesNotDefined Hinit k hk'
      simp_all
    have Hdis' : (ks.zip vs).unzip.1.Disjoint (ks'.zip vs').unzip.1 := by
      simpa only [List.unzip_zip (UpdateStatesLength Hup),
        List.unzip_zip (InitStatesLength Hinit)] using Hdis
    have Hcomm : updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks vs) ks' vs' =
        updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs := by
      simpa [updatedStates] using (updatedStatesComm (σ:=σ) Hdis')
    have Hdef : isDefined (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks := by
      unfold updatedStates
      exact updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' Hup)
    have Hupd : UpdateStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs
        (updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs) :=
      updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength Hup) Hdef
    have Hfinal : updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs = σ'' := by
      rw [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup]
      exact Hcomm.symm
    exact Hfinal ▸ Hupd

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  rw [funext_iff]
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := not_forall.mp h
  simp at hx₀
  have hs : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
    have hn : ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ ≠ 0 := fun e => hx₀ (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp e)
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (by simpa using (real_inner_self_nonneg' (x := f x₀))) (Ne.symm hn)
  have hc : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
    Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hcont⟩ :=
    Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hc.continuousAt (⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ / 2) (by exact half_pos hs)
  have hi : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ, 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
    intro x hx
    have hh := hcont (Metric.mem_ball.mp hx)
    have hh' : |⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ - ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ| < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ / 2 := by assumption
    linarith [(abs_lt.mp hh').1]
  have hb : ∃ φ : Y → ℝ, IsTestFunction φ ∧ φ x₀ > 0 ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Function.support φ, 0 ≤ φ x) ∧
      Function.support φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ (δ / 2) := by
    haveI : HasContDiffBump Y := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
    let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 4, δ / 2, by positivity, by linarith⟩
    refine ⟨φ.toFun, ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩,
      φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self φ.rOut_pos), (fun _ _ => φ.nonneg), ?_⟩
    rw [ContDiffBump.support_eq]
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφ₀, hφnonneg, hφsupp⟩ := hb
  let g : Y → V := fun x => φ x • f x₀
  have hgt : IsTestFunction g := IsTestFunction.smul_right hφ contDiff_const
  have hzero := hg g hgt
  simp only [g, inner_smul_right'] at hzero
  have hsub : Function.support φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ δ :=
    hφsupp.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith))
  have hnonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Function.support φ
    · exact mul_nonneg (hφnonneg x hx) (hi x (hsub hx)).le
    · simp [Function.notMem_support.mp hx]
  have hpos : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ :=
    (Continuous.mul hφ.smooth.continuous hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
      hφ.supp.mul_right hnonneg (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hφ₀ hs))
  linarith

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (fun s => ∂[j] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i
  calc _
    _= ∂ₜ (fun t =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, Space.deriv j (fun x => magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c A t x (j, i)) x -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity 𝓕.c J t x i) t := by
        conv_lhs =>
          enter [1]
          change fun t => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) t
          enter [t]
          rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
            (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
            time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∂ₜ (fun t => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x) t -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      rw [Time.deriv_eq]
      rw [fderiv_fun_sub]
      simp only
      rw [fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt]
      rw [fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]
      rfl
      · exact ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
      · exact hJt.differentiableAt.const_mul _
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ((∑ j, ∂ₜ (fun t => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x)) t) -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * (∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t) := by
      congr
      rw [Time.deriv_eq]
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum fun i _ => (hBt i).differentiableAt]
      simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
      rfl
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∑ j, ∂[j] (fun x => ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · x (j, i)) t)) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      congr
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
      congr
      funext k
      rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv]
      apply magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff
      apply hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) *(∑ j, ∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x -
        ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x)) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext k
        congr
        funext x
        rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out))]
    _ = (1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x -
          ∂[j] (fun x => ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x)) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext j
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hEd _ _).differentiableAt (hEd _ _).differentiableAt]
        rfl
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by simp only [ Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
        1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[i] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        funext j
        rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs _)]
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∂[i] (fun x => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        rw [fderiv_fun_sum]
        simp only [_root_.sum_apply, ← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        intro j _
        exact (hEd j j).differentiableAt
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∂[i] (fun x => (∇ ⬝ (A.electricField 𝓕.c t)) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        rfl
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀ ^ 2) * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr 2
        rw [isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix] at h

        conv_lhs =>
          enter [2, 2, x]
          rw [(h t x).1]
        trans 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * Space.deriv i
            (fun x => (1/ 𝓕.ε₀) * LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity 𝓕.c J t x) x
        · congr
          funext x
          ring
        · rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
          rw [fderiv_const_mul]
          simp only [ _root_.smul_apply, ← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
          apply Differentiable.differentiableAt
          apply LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
          exact hJ.differentiable (by decide)
        · exact hA
        · exact hJ
      _ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
            𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
            𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
          simp only [ FreeSpace.c_sq]
          field_simp

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
    Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))
  change pb b (Basis.mem_span _ b)
  apply Submodule.span_induction
  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
      Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) =
        ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * ofCrAnListF φs))
    change pa a (Basis.mem_span _ a)
    apply Submodule.span_induction
    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pa]
      let l1 := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)) ++
        List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'
      let l2 := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs ++
        List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
          (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))
      have h1 : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs)) =
          crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
        have h := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs (by simp_all)
        rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp,
          crAnTimeOrderList, h]
        simp only [List.append_assoc, decide_not, Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append,
          map_smul, map_mul, l1, l2, mul_assoc]
      have h2 : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)) =
          crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
        have h := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs (by simp_all)
        rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by simp,
          crAnTimeOrderList, h]
        simp only [List.append_assoc, decide_not, Bool.decide_and, ofCrAnListF_append,
          map_smul, map_mul, l1, l2, mul_assoc]
        simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
        rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
      calc
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
              ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
            crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) •
              𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
                ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs))) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
          module
        _ = ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs)) -
            𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
              ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)) := by
          rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul]
          module
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) *
              (ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) -
                𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) • ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ])) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
          rw [h1, h2]
          simp only [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, mul_sub, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, sub_mul,
            smul_sub, smul_smul]
          rw [mul_comm (𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ))
            (crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))]
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
              ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
          congr 1
          rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
          simp only [ofCrAnListF_cons, ofCrAnListF_nil, mul_one, map_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul]
        _ = ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
            𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs)) := by
          rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
            (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]

          rw [← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
          have h := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
          simp only [List.append_assoc, l1, l2] at h ⊢
          rw [← h, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
          rw [map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul]
          by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
          · simp [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq]
          · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign,
              Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (by simp_all),

    · simp only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, pa]
    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy

    · intro x hx hpx

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    cases ih_l rfl l with
    | inl val_l =>
        cases ih_r rfl r with
        | inl val_r =>
            obtain ⟨σ, b, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
            exact Or.inr ⟨b ^ᵗᵗ t₂, Red.abs l.wf.2.1 val_r⟩
        | inr red_r =>
            obtain ⟨t₂', red_r⟩ := red_r
            exact Or.inr ⟨t₁.app t₂', Red.appᵣ val_l red_r⟩
    | inr red_l =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', red_l⟩ := red_l
        exact Or.inr ⟨t₁'.app t₂, Red.appₗ r.wf.2.1 red_l⟩
  case tapp σ' der _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, b, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exact Or.inr ⟨b ^ᵗᵞ σ', Red.tabs der.wf.2.1 (by grind)⟩
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', red⟩ := red
        exact Or.inr ⟨.tapp t' σ', Red.tapp (by grind) red⟩
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der _ ih _ =>
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val => exact Or.inr ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, Red.let_body val (by grind)⟩
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', red⟩ := red
        exact Or.inr ⟨t₁'.let' t₂, Red.let_bind red (by grind)⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val => exact Or.inl (.inl val)
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', red⟩ := red
        exact Or.inr ⟨.inl t', Red.inl red⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val => exact Or.inl (.inr val)
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', red⟩ := red
        exact Or.inr ⟨.inr t', Red.inr red⟩
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨u, lr⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
        cases lr with
        | inl eq =>
            subst t₁
            cases val with
            | inl val_u => exact Or.inr ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ u, Red.case_inl val_u (by grind) (by grind)⟩
        | inr eq =>
            subst t₁
            cases val with
            | inr val_u => exact Or.inr ⟨t₃ ^ᵗᵗ u, Red.case_inr val_u (by grind) (by grind)⟩
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', red⟩ := red
        exact Or.inr ⟨t₁'.case t₂ t₃, Red.case red (by grind) (by grind)⟩
  case sub => grind
  case abs σ _ τ L _ _ =>
    exact Or.inl (Value.abs (LC.abs L (by grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]) (by grind)))
  case tabs L _ _ =>
    exact Or.inl (Value.tabs (LC.tabs L (by grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]) (by grind)))

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha hb =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha' hb' =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha ha'
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb hb'
      exact ⟨x ⬝ y, .par hx.1 hy.1, .par hx.2 hy.2⟩
    case red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible a' ha]
      exact ⟨b', .red_I b', hb⟩
    case red_K =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha
      rw [hx.2]
      exact ⟨x, .red_K x b', hx.1⟩
    case red_S a c =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx⟩ := Sab_irreducible a c a' ha
      rw [hx.2.2]
      refine ⟨x ⬝ b' ⬝ (y ⬝ b'), .red_S x y b', ?_⟩
      exact .par (.par hx.1 hb) (.par hx.2.1 hb)
  case red_I =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a₁, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    case par c a₁' hc ha =>
      rw [I_irreducible c hc]
      exact ⟨a₁', ha, .red_I a₁'⟩
    case red_I => exact ⟨a₁, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_K c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a₁, .refl _, .red_K a₁ c⟩
    case par a' c' ha hc =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₁ a' ha
      rw [hx.2]
      exact ⟨x, hx.1, .red_K x c'⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨a₁, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b d hd
      rw [hx.2.2]
      exact ⟨x ⬝ c' ⬝ (y ⬝ c'), .par (.par hx.1 hc) (.par hx.2.1 hc), .red_S ..⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .refl _⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    unfold lts
    constructor
    · intro s1' htr
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨s2', htr', hr'⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
        exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceL htr', .bisim hr'⟩
      | choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceR htr, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    · intro s2' htr
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨s1', htr', hr'⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
        exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceL htr', .bisim hr'⟩
      | choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceR htr, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    constructor
    · intro s1' htr
      obtain ⟨s2', htr', hr'⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
      exact ⟨s2', htr', .bisim hr'⟩
    · intro s2' htr
      obtain ⟨s1', htr', hr'⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
      exact ⟨s1', htr', .bisim hr'⟩

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C_i := (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_H := Code.distFromCode f C_i
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 (⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_i_plus_steps := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩

  have h_d_i_gt_0 : d_i > 0 := by
    dsimp [d_i, BBF_CodeDistance]
    
    
    omega

  have h_C_i_nonempty : Nonempty C_i := by
    simp only [nonempty_subtype]
    exact Submodule.nonempty (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i.val, by omega⟩)

  obtain ⟨g', h_g'_mem, h_g'_min_card⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw
    = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    let S := (fun (g : C_i) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
      f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
    have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := by
      refine Set.image_nonempty.mpr ?_
      exact Set.univ_nonempty
    have h_sInf_mem : sInf S ∈ S := Nat.sInf_mem hS_nonempty
    
    rw [Set.mem_image] at h_sInf_mem
    rcases h_sInf_mem with ⟨g_subtype, _, h_eq⟩
    exact ⟨g_subtype.val, g_subtype.property, by exact id (Eq.symm h_eq)⟩

  have h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    change (Δ₀(f, g') : ℕ∞) ≤ ↑d_fw * ((2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
    rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_le_coe, h_g'_min_card]
    set ΔH := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    have h_dist_eq_card : hammingDist f g' = ΔH.card := by
      simp only [hammingDist, ne_eq, ΔH]
    rw []
    set Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    simp only at *
    have hFinType_Y_bad : Fintype Y_bad := by exact Fintype.ofFinite ↑Y_bad
    have h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points : ΔH ⊆ Finset.biUnion Y_bad.toFinset
        (t := fun y => ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
          (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((2:ℕ)^steps)))).toFinset) := by
      intro x hx_in_ΔH
      simp only [ΔH, Finset.mem_filter] at hx_in_ΔH
      let y_of_x := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      use y_of_x
      have h_elemenet_Y_bad : y_of_x ∈ Y_bad.toFinset := by
        simp only [fiberwiseDisagreementSet, iteratedQuotientMap, ne_eq, Subtype.exists,
          Set.toFinset_setOf, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Y_bad]
        let X := x.val
        have h_X_in_source : X ∈ sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) := by
          exact Submodule.coe_mem x
        use X
        use h_X_in_source
        have h_forward_iterated_qmap : Polynomial.eval X
            (intermediateNormVpoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑i, by omega⟩
              ⟨steps, by simp only; omega⟩) = y_of_x := by
          rfl
        have h_eval_diff : f ⟨X, by omega⟩ ≠ g' ⟨X, by omega⟩ := by
          unfold X
          simp only [Subtype.coe_eta, ne_eq, hx_in_ΔH, not_false_eq_true]
        simp only [h_forward_iterated_qmap, Subtype.coe_eta, h_eval_diff,
          not_false_eq_true, and_self]
      simp only [h_elemenet_Y_bad, true_and]
      set qMapFiber := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y_of_x)
      simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and]
      use (pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (x := x))
      exact is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega)
        (x := x) (y := y_of_x).mp (by rfl)
    apply (Finset.card_le_card h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points).trans
    calc
      _ ≤ Y_bad.toFinset.card * 2 ^ steps := by
        apply Finset.card_biUnion_le_card_mul
        intro y hy
        simp only [Set.toFinset_card]
        have h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point := card_qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β
          (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i steps h_i_add_steps
        simp only [Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset, Subtype.forall]
          at h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point
        have hy_card := h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point (a := y)
          (b := Submodule.coe_mem y)
        simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset, hy_card]
        exact le_rfl
      _ = Y_bad.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
        rw [Set.toFinset_card, ← _root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq, card_eq_fintype_card]

  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    apply le_trans (a := d_H) (c := d_fw * 2 ^ steps) (b := hammingDist f g')
    · simp only [distFromCode, SetLike.mem_coe, hammingDist, ne_eq, d_H]
      apply sInf_le
      use g'
    · exact h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size

  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_i_plus_steps - 1 := by
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)

  have h_algebraic_identity : (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp [d_i, d_i_plus_steps, BBF_CodeDistance]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add]
    have h1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i := by
      rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev (h1 := by omega) (h2 := by omega),
        Nat.add_sub_cancel (n := i) (m := steps)]
    have h2 : (ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps) = ℓ - i := by
      rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev (h1 := by omega) (h2 := by omega),
        Nat.add_sub_cancel (n := i) (m := steps)]
    rw [h1, h2]

  have h_dH_ne_top : d_H ≠ ⊤ := by
    simp only [ne_eq, d_H]
    rw [Code.distFromCode_eq_top_iff_empty f C_i]
    exact Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty'.mp h_C_i_nonempty

  let d_H_nat := ENat.toNat d_H
  have h_dH_eq : d_H = d_H_nat := (ENat.coe_toNat h_dH_ne_top).symm

  have h_final_inequality : 2 * d_H_nat ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    have h_bridge_nat : d_H_nat ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
      rw [←ENat.coe_le_coe]
      exact le_of_eq_of_le (id (Eq.symm h_dH_eq)) h_dist_bridge
    calc 2 * d_H_nat
      _ ≤ 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) := by gcongr
      _ = (2 * d_fw) * 2 ^ steps := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps := by gcongr
      _ = d_i - 1 := h_algebraic_identity

  simp only [d_H, d_H_nat] at h_dH_eq
  rw [h_dH_eq]
  change ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * ↑Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat < ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_lt_coe]
  apply Nat.lt_of_le_pred (n := 2 * Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat) (m := d_i) (h := h_d_i_gt_0)
    h_final_inequality

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  simp only
  intro y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  set P_i := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) coeffs
  set new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      
      have h2 : 2^(ℓ - i) = 2^(ℓ - (i + 1)) * 2 := by
        conv_rhs => enter[2]; rw [←Nat.pow_one 2]
        rw [←pow_add]; congr
        rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev (h1 := by omega) (h2 := by omega)]
        rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel (n := i) (m := 1)]
      omega
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1)) (i := 1)
      · omega
      · omega
    ⟩)
  have h_eval_qMap_x₀ : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval x₀.val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) x₀
    simp only [Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    rw [h.symm]
    have h_res := is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)
      (x := x₀) (y := y).mpr (by rw [pointToIterateQuotientIndex_qMap_total_fiber_eq_self])
    rw [h_res]
  have h_eval_qMap_x₁ : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval x₁.val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) x₁
    simp only [Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    rw [h.symm]
    have h_res := is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)

  set P₀_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) => coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by

        mul_comm (a := Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal))]; rw [mul_assoc]

proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  classical
  intro ϑ
  induction ϑ with
  | zero =>
    intro u
    contradiction
  | succ ϑ_sub_1 ih =>
    cases ϑ_sub_1 with
    | zero =>
      simp only [zero_add, zero_lt_one, forall_const]
      intro u
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (u := u)]
      intro hprob_gt
      simp_rw [prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
        (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),
        Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hprob_gt
      have h_correlated_agreement := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hprob_gt
      simp only [jointProximityNat₂] at h_correlated_agreement
      have h_u_eq : u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
        funext i
        fin_cases i <;> rfl
      rw [h_u_eq.symm] at h_correlated_agreement
      exact h_correlated_agreement
    | succ ϑ_sub_2 =>
      intro hϑ_gt_0 u hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
      set U₀ : Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)) → Word A ι :=
        (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1) u).1
      set U₁ : Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)) → Word A ι :=
        (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1) u).2
      unfold jointProximityNat
      simp only
      have h_finsnoc_eq_r : ∀ r : Fin (ϑ_sub_2 + 1 + 1) → F,
          Fin.snoc (fun (i : Fin (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)) ↦ r i.castSucc)
            (r (Fin.last (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) = r := fun r => by
        funext i
        by_cases h : i = Fin.last (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)
        · simp only [h, Fin.snoc_last]
        · have h_i_ne_last_val : i.val ≠ Fin.last (ϑ_sub_2 + 1) := by omega
          rw [Fin.val_last] at h_i_ne_last_val
          simp only [Fin.snoc, Fin.castSucc_castLT, cast_eq, dite_eq_ite,
            ite_eq_left_iff]
          omega
      let P : F → (Fin (ϑ_sub_2 + 1) → F) → Prop := fun r_last r_init =>
        Δ₀(multilinearCombine (u := u) (r := Fin.snoc r_init r_last), MC) ≤ e
      let hP_split_r_last := prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
        (ϑ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1) (F := F) (P := P)
      unfold P at hP_split_r_last
      simp_rw [h_finsnoc_eq_r] at hP_split_r_last
      rw [hP_split_r_last] at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
      let ϑ_pred := ϑ_sub_2 + 1
      have multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine
          (r_init : Fin ϑ_pred → F) (r_last : F) :
          multilinearCombine u (Fin.snoc r_init r_last) =
            multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init := by
        rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form]
        simp only [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.init_snoc]
        rfl
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine]
        at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
      let R_star_set := R_star_tensor MC (m := ϑ_pred) (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁
      have h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q : Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[r ∈ R_star_set]
          > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
        exact prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) (ϑ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1)
          (u := u) (e := e) hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
      have h_line_close_to_C_m : ∀ (r : R_star_set),
          jointProximityNat (u := affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r.val) (e := e) (C := MC) := by
        intro r_in_Rstar
        apply correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor
          (ih := fun u_prev => ih (Nat.zero_lt_succ _) u_prev) (u := u)
      have h_C_m_gap := h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)) (Nat.one_le_two_pow)
      have h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q :
          Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[
            Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation
              (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₀))
              (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₁)) (r := r),
              ((MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)))))) ≤ e] >
              (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
        apply lt_of_le_of_lt' _ h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q
        have h_r_implies : ∀ (r : F), r ∈ R_star_set →
            Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation
              (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₀))
              (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₁)) (r := r),
              ((MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)))))) ≤ e := by
          intro r hr_in_Rstar
          specialize h_line_close_to_C_m ⟨r, hr_in_Rstar⟩
          unfold jointProximityNat at h_line_close_to_C_m
          assumption
        exact Pr_le_Pr_of_implies (D := $ᵖ F)
          (g := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation
            (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₀))
            (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₁)) (r := r),
            ((MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)))))) ≤ e)
          (f := fun r => r ∈ R_star_set) h_r_implies
      have h_final_gap : jointProximityNat₂
          (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₀))
          (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₁)) (e := e)
          (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)))) := by
        exact h_C_m_gap
          (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₀))
          (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₁))

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hfin : Set.Finite (Set.range f) := by
    have hI : Set.Finite (Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)) := by
      apply Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_mem_finset (Finset.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)))
      intro x hx
      simp only [mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Icc, mem_setOf_eq] at hx ⊢
      exact hx
    apply hI.subset
    rintro x ⟨n, rfl⟩
    have h0 := hB n
    
    
    
    simp only [mem_Icc, Prod.le_def, f]
    simp_all only [ge_iff_le, ne_eq, and_self]
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ : ∃ i j, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    by_contra! h
    have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
      intro a b hab
      by_cases h' : a = b
      · exact h'
      · have : a < b ∨ b < a := by omega
        rcases this with hlt | hlt
        · exact (h a b hlt hab).elim
        · exact False.elim (h b a hlt hab.symm)
    exact hfin.not_infinite (Set.infinite_range_of_injective hinj)
  have heq : u i = u j ∧ u (i + 1) = u (j + 1) ∧ u (i + 2) = u (j + 2) ∧ u (i + 3) = u (j + 3) := by
    simpa [f, Prod.mk.injEq] using heq
  have hstep (a b : ℕ) (ha : 4 ≤ a) (hb : 4 ≤ b)
      (h1 : u (a - 1) = u (b - 1)) (h2 : u (a - 2) = u (b - 2))
      (h3 : u (a - 3) = u (b - 3)) (h4 : u (a - 4) = u (b - 4)) : u a = u b := by
    have ea := (hu a ha).1
    have eb := (hu b hb).1
    have er : (u a : ℝ) = u b := by rw [ea, eb, h1, h2, h3, h4]
    exact_mod_cast er
  have hseq : ∀ m, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      by_cases h0 : m = 0
      · subst m; simpa using heq.1
      by_cases h1 : m = 1
      · subst m; simpa using heq.2.1
      by_cases h2 : m = 2
      · subst m; simpa using heq.2.2.1
      by_cases h3 : m = 3
      · subst m; simpa using heq.2.2.2
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 4 := ⟨m - 4, by omega⟩
      have p1 : u (i + (k + 4) - 1) = u (j + (k + 4) - 1) := by tauto
      have p2 : u (i + (k + 4) - 2) = u (j + (k + 4) - 2) := by
        have e1 : i + (k + 4) - 2 = i + (k + 2) := by exact rfl
        have e2 : j + (k + 4) - 2 = j + (k + 2) := by omega
        rw [e1, e2]; exact ih (k + 2) (by omega)
      have p3 : u (i + (k + 4) - 3) = u (j + (k + 4) - 3) := by
        have e1 : i + (k + 4) - 3 = i + (k + 1) := by omega
        have e2 : j + (k + 4) - 3 = j + (k + 1) := by omega
        rw [e1, e2]; exact ih (k + 1) (by omega)
      have p4 : u (i + (k + 4) - 4) = u (j + (k + 4) - 4) := by
        have e1 : i + (k + 4) - 4 = i + k := by omega
        have e2 : j + (k + 4) - 4 = j + k := by omega
        rw [e1, e2]; exact ih k (by omega)
      exact hstep (i + (k + 4)) (j + (k + 4)) (by omega) (by omega) p1 p2 p3 p4
  refine ⟨i, j - i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · omega
  · intro n hn
    have h := hseq (n - i)
    have e1 : i + (n - i) = n := by omega
    have e2 : j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) := by omega
    rw [e1, e2] at h
    exact h.symm

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have h_alt : ∀ A : Set S, A ∉ P → Aᶜ ∈ P := by grind
  have h_not_both : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hAc
    apply hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc
    ext x
    simp
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) \ P
  have h_card : P.card = Q.card := by
    exact Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
      (fun A hA => by grind)
      (fun A hA => h_alt A (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hA).2)
      (by intro A hA; simp)
      (by intro A hA; simp)
  have h_sum : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card (Finset.subset_univ P)
    change Q.card + P.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card at h
    have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
      simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
    rw [hu] at h
    omega
  have hn : Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S := by
    have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card S := by positivity
    omega
  have h_pow : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    calc
      2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 ^ 1 := rfl
      _ = 2 ^ ((Fintype.card S - 1) + 1) := by rw [← pow_add]
      _ = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by rw [hn]
  omega

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have hde := ((hrelation d e).mp h.1).2
  have hef := ((hrelation e f).mp h.2).2
  have hchange (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then y j else x j) =
        digits_to_num x + (y i - x i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    simp only [hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      (∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then y j else x j) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ)) =
          ∑ j : Fin 9, (x j * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) +
            (if j = i then (y j - x j) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) else 0)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [hji] <;> ring
      _ = (∑ j : Fin 9, x j * (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ)) +
          (y i - x i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
  have ha : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d := by
    intro i
    have hi := hde i
    rw [hchange d e i] at hi
    convert hi using 1 <;> ring
  have hb : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e := by
    intro i
    have hi := hef i
    rw [hchange e f i] at hi
    convert hi using 1 <;> abel
  have hnum : digits_to_num e = digits_to_num d +
      ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    simp only [hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin 9, e i * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)) =
          ∑ i : Fin 9, (d i * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) +
            (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        ring
      _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hsum : 7 ∣ ∑ i : Fin 9,
      ((e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d) := by
    apply Finset.dvd_sum
    intro i hi
    exact ha i
  have hsum' : 7 ∣ (∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)) +
      9 * digits_to_num d := by
    have heq : (∑ i : Fin 9,
        ((e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d)) =
        (∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)) +
          9 * digits_to_num d := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
        Int.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rw [heq] at hsum
    exact hsum
  have hnd : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    have hdvd : 7 ∣ 7 * digits_to_num d := ⟨digits_to_num d, rfl⟩
    have heq : digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d =
        ((∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)) +
          9 * digits_to_num d) - 7 * digits_to_num d := by
      rw [hnum]
      ring
    rw [heq]
    exact dvd_sub hsum' hdvd
  intro i
  have hprod : 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    have htmp : 7 ∣
        ((f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num e -
          (digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d)) +
          ((e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) + digits_to_num d) :=
      dvd_add (dvd_sub (hb i) hnd) (ha i)
    convert htmp using 1 <;> ring
  have hnot : ¬ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
    intro hpw
    have hn : (7 : ℕ) ∣ (10 : ℕ) ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      norm_cast at hpw ⊢
    have hp : Nat.Prime 7 := by decide
    have hdv : (7 : ℕ) ∣ 10 := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hn
    norm_num at hdv
  have hdvd : (7 : ℤ) ∣ (f i - d i) ∨ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) :=
    (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by decide)).dvd_mul.mp hprod
  have hfd : (7 : ℤ) ∣ f i - d i := by
    rcases hdvd with hfd | hpw
    · exact hfd
    · exact (hnot hpw).elim
  have hn := dvd_neg.mpr hfd
  convert hn using 1 <;> ring
